# `oaap app rebuild`

build an instance again on a freshly pulled base, falling back to the previous image (RFC-0071).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app rebuild [--back] name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `--back` | go back to the image the last rebuild kept |
